title: Amazon SageMaker endpoint via Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda
description: Deploys a SageMaker Jumpstart model endpoint and an API Gateway endpoint.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The model deployed in this pattern can be changed by modifying the MODEL_ID attribute in app.py file.
The API Gateway is protected using an API Key. To query the API Gateway endpoint, x-api-key header needs to be added to the HTTP request.
